MUNICIPAL PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT - GOVERNMENT NOTICE

1. ISSUANCE OF NOTICE. Public notice is hereby issued by the Competent Authority of the Municipal Department regarding rainwater harvesting compliance.

1.1 Statutory Mandate: Pursuant to the Municipal Building Bye-Laws, 2024, all plots exceeding 250 square meters must maintain functional harvesting pits.

1.1.1 Gazette Reference: This requirement was notified in the Official Gazette by the Ministry of Urban Affairs.

2. APPLICABILITY AND INSPECTION. Designated ward officers are hereby authorized to inspect residential and commercial properties.

2.1 Compliance Checklist: Property owners are directed to ensure the following standards:
(a) Clean silt chambers and intact filtration mesh prior to the monsoon inspection.
(b) Submission of a photographic compliance certificate to the zonal authority:
(i) Uploaded via the municipal citizen portal with property tax ID.
(ii) Verified by an empanelled civil engineer within 30 days of this notice.

3. DEADLINE FOR COMPLIANCE. All corrective works must be completed within 30 days from the date of publication of this government notice.

Clause 4: Show Cause Notice. Non-compliant owners shall receive a show cause notice requiring a written reply within 15 days.

Section 5: Penalty for Non-Compliance. Failure to comply within the stipulated period shall attract a statutory penalty of Rs. 10,000 plus disconnection of auxiliary water supply.

Section 5.1: Continuing Default. An additional daily penalty of Rs. 500 shall apply until compliance is verified.

Article 6: Appellate Authority. Any person aggrieved by an order under this notice may file an appeal before the Appellate Authority within 30 days.

SIGNATORY AND OFFICE SEAL
Issued under the hand and seal of the undersigned Joint Commissioner, Municipal Corporation, for immediate compliance.
